why_trail.why: Baseline loaded. The single mutating chokepoint where HARD is evaluated for a BEGIN is _trip_hard_gate; main() persists on the EngineError path for non-current verbs, which is what makes a begin-refused entry durable. Four existing tests assert a refused begin leaves the spine byte-identical and will need the ledger key excluded from that comparison.

Ledger writer shipped at the single mutating chokepoint. _append_trip_entry (setdefault, tl-N ids, never mutates a prior entry) is called from _trip_hard_gate's two branches: begin-released before the release return, begin-refused before the raise. dispatch now passes verb=v. Entry carries the eight named fields plus why_ref (the live why-record id), which is what lets the predicate key on the current understanding. Seven ledger tests green, each a two-world pair.

begin_over_line_records is the compliance signal: a pure selector over stored trip_ledger entries whose why_ref equals the live why-record id. Emptiness is the predicate, and emptiness is explicitly NOT a claim of compliance. The sharpest test holds the ledger byte-identical across both worlds and moves only which understanding is live.

The HARD branch of _trip_advisory now computes the compliance fact ONCE, before its two sub-branches, and appends the same TRIP LEDGER line to both. Both sub-branches matter: the already-requested one is the RELEASED case, where work actually proceeded over the line. Healthy-world strings are pinned by equality, so the added line is the only difference.

Fail-safe, engine-only, backward compatibility and survey guards shipped; the four pre-existing no-mutation guards reconciled to compare with the ledger lifted out AND assert the ledger's own growth. Full suite 1858 passed / 2 skipped / 820 subtests against the 9997c32d baseline of 1833 / 2 / 808: +25 passed is exactly my 25 new tests; the subtest delta is +12 not +13 because test_context_manifest's clean-file sweep excludes scripts/checklist_engine.py while it is uncommitted. That subtest returns once the change is committed.

CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md now documents the trip_ledger (storage-model line, field table, both outcomes, the begin-released honesty note, the two deliberate non-write-sites), the pure selector and its keying to the live understanding, the fail-safe that an empty result is not a claim of compliance, backward compatibility, engine-written-only, and the limit verbatim. I also corrected a line the change falsified: the Trip section said a HARD refusal 'never mutates state', which is no longer true. The gate refused once because the limit sentence wrapped across two lines and its own grep check could not match -- fixed by unwrapping, not by weakening the check.
